name: Super-resolution (recover detail)
license: Apache-2.0 (Swin2SR; module code by Deepshot Studio)
author: Gnomalab Estudio
description: Runs the image through Swin2SR x2 (AI upscaling) and brings it back to the original size: it recovers fine detail and cleans up compression and noise without changing the size (Look layers always keep the image size). It needs the «Swin2SR x2» model (50 MB, Apache 2.0), downloaded once and used locally. It is slow on big images, and very slow on CPU.

params.name: strength
params.label: Strength
params.tooltip: How much of the recovered detail is applied: 0 = the image as it is, 1 = the model's result.

params.name: tile
params.label: Tile
params.tooltip: Size in pixels of the pieces the image is processed in. Smaller = less memory (useful with 8 GB of VRAM or on a Mac); larger = a bit faster.
